Dynastic Resonance

The Moon (Ancient Blood). Target a hex held by another Domain: that Domain's standing toward you moves one step warmer on the relations ladder (at war → hostile → unfriendly → neutral → friendly → allied).

Cost: Soft Power 8 · Diplomacy 8 marks.
